_readme: Cockpit layout — edit and relaunch, no code changes needed.
Rects are {x, y, w, h} in canvas pixels, relative to the console
the widget lives on. NEGATIVE x measures from the console's RIGHT
edge (use for right-aligned instruments like the radar).
panel_height/panel_frac size the console slabs; flat_frac is how
much of the width stays level before the slope; drop_frac is how
far down the slope reaches (0-1 of panel height).
